title: bulkRNAseq CD34+ cells in MDS/AML patients (i4MDS data)
description: Processed bulk RNA-seq data generated from CD34+ cells from patients with myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML), deposited in the i4MDS DataSpace.

title: Microbiome Abundances in Feces of Patients with Myeloid Neoplasms (i4MDS data)
description: Processed microbiome abundance data generated from shotgun metagenomic sequencing of feces samples from patients with myeloid neoplasms, deposited in the i4MDS DataSpace.
